title: Request lifecycle map
prompt: Map the life of a POST /invoices request from the socket to the JSON file: which module parses the body, how routing matches the path, where the invoice id is allocated, how it is written to disk, and what the response contains. Write it as a report with a numbered sequence and cite each file and function. Note anything that would break under two concurrent requests. No code changes.
answer: No preference; write the report with what you have.
